reviews.x: I used a different product that worked well, but if I put too much and got it in my eye, it would sting. Cos Naturals does not sting if you accidentally put too much and then blink. I have noticed that both my top and bottom lashes have thickened and are very long. I always get complements...even when I am not wearing mascara. I would definitely buy this product again.

The eyelash/eyebrow product I'd been using for thinning brows was discontinued.  I decided to give this a try.  There was no break in usage between the two products.  My eyebrows now look as bad as they did before I started that discontinued product.  The search resumes.
It works. "Clean" ingredients. Absorbs quickly
WOW, it works. I have improved my eyelashes so much.

No matter how disappointing the application process was, if I had received a better result (lash growth) I would be happy. I have used another product before but lost it in a move so I tried this one. After 6 months I am not seeing any results. When I pull the applicator out of the bottle, there is always a slow but definite drop that comes along after I've wiped the first lid, then either floods my eye or the drip falls off and is wasted. I bought two--one for home and one for my overnight work

I would be very careful with this product. I would apply a small amount to a tiny section of your eyelashes, before ever applying to the whole eye. I had a bad allergic reaction to this product. My eyelids got all puffy and itchy, my vision was blurry, and I looked like I had a bad case of pink eye in both eyes. Thank goodness I didn't have anywhere to go the day I tried this product out! reviews.t: Don’t Let the Low Price Fool You
reviews.x: The upper eyelashes on my left eye have been falling out in cycles for almost 3 years.  My doctor prescribed Latisse and not only did it not work, it actually made my condition worse😩. I tried COS Pepride Lash because It had peptides ( which is supposed to help with eyelash growth).  I didn’t really have high expectations because the price was so low but this product actually worked.  My eyelashes aren’t as full as my right eye, but they haven’t fallen out since I started to use COS Peptide Lash

I have bought this before and in the ingredients portion of the description, and my last purchase, myristoyl is second ingredient. In this new one I just ordered and recieved myristoyl is third ingredient,  eventhough on the amazon product info it shows as second ingredient.  I dont like this switch! What I had researched Myristoyl is the lash growing ingredient I want. I dont know how to fix this or even if it can be fixed. Very frustrating!

I recently purchased this because I got eyelash extensions and I wanted to keep my lashes strong. Just serum has worked great it has strengthened and elongated as well as thickened my lashes. I have used serums in the past that have caused irritation and redness to my eyes, this serum has no side effects. I put it on both my top and bottom lashes before bed and I have seen it significant difference in the growth of both.

reviews.t: but I am better off just waiting after I am done being pregnant ...
reviews.x: It's been a few months and haven't had any results. Had to switch to this stuff because I am pregnant and need to use natural products, but I am better off just waiting after I am done being pregnant and using a legit product

reviews.x: Been using this for almost a month & can't really tell diff on length/growth of my lashes....will continue with it & hope it really works cause I purchased it due to the positive reviews!
I definitely see a difference in eyelashes and brows! Will be reordering. Used a similar product for $100.00.  I truly believe this works better!

No matter what anyone tells you, eyelash extensions completely ruin your natural lashes. I was so embarrassed when I took my extensions off and had stubs for eyelashes. I have pretty long natural lashes, but they are blonde so I got extensions for a boost ! I could barely apply mascara to the stubs leftover from extensions, and everything says it would take up to 3 months for my lashes to be back to normal. reviews.t: A good alternative for the price
reviews.x: This product does not provide miraculous results, however it does improve the condition of my lashes and makes them stronger so they can grow.  I didn't notice any results for at least 5-6 weeks.  At first I was disappointed because I had been losing lashes and that problem continued after I started using the lash treatment.  However, I discovered that my eyelash curler was pulling them out.  Now that I've addressed that issue, my lashes have grown and lengthened.  I've purchased this product ab

reviews.t: It's no Latisse but worked for me
reviews.x: Been using it for about a month and I do see improvement in the fullness and length of my lashes. It's not a significant result like Latisse which I've used before. But I much prefer it since it's fraction of the cost and is easily procured. I've not experience any irritation with this product; it actually have gotten in my eye. I just wiped it and it was fine. But that's just me, as the product suggests, test it out before full application. It is generally a smart move with anything that close

reviews.t: Use every single night for best results. It works
reviews.x: I've heard of eyelash growth serums but wasn't sure they would really work. I purchased few less expansive serums on Amazon and did not like them. I haven't got any results. I'm using COS Naturals vitamin c serum and noticed that they have eyelash growth serum too. After using this serum every single night I can really see improvements. My lashes are much longer and seems thicker as well. I strongly recommend trying this product! It really works

reviews.t: They are long and look like they used to
reviews.x: I am really starting to think there is something to this. Have been using for about 3 weeks or so and I can def tell in lashes. They are long and look like they used to. Not sure about the eyebrows, but that's ok. Its worth it for the lashes for sure. I put this on after I shower in the mornings, maybe 15 minutes before my eye makeup and it still works just fine.

I'm writing this review for my grandma who used my account for this purchase, her words as follows: If I could rate this on a minus scale I absolutely would. Complete garbage. Waste of money. Used for 6wks no growth. Crappy!!!

I yanked out a bit my lashes with a curler. Was panicked. In the 2 weeks of using nightly, COS Naturals has improved growth and thickness to my lashes that I never imagined possible. Quite happy with results.

This lash serum is amazing. I used to use another product but when I became pregnant it was no longer safe to use. I like that this is natural and doesn’t sting. With the same amazing results! Love it.
My lashes look fuller and longer after only two weeks. No negative side effects at all! Can't wait to see what the next few weeks will do!
It does lengthen lashes.  It worked very well.

Cos Naturals Peptide Lash really works! It can take a few weeks in the beginning to see results, but my lashes are much longer and thicker and they have stayed that way even if I skip a few days. I am in my mid 50s and my lashes were starting to thin out. This product does not give me any problems (no itching, burning, redness, etc) and this is wonderful. I don't even need to use mascara anymore, it's that good. Highly recommend!

This is my fifth brand, including Latisse and plain ‘ol cod liver oil, which gets great reviews (it didn’t work for me). I’ve been through three bottles of this so far and it’s worked extremely well. Lashes are longer and eyebrows have filled in better than with any other brand. It seem best to alternate brands every two to three bottles, but I’ll say I stopped paying for Latisse after finding this and another on Amazon.

reviews.t: As I was reading through the reviews that's what buyers were most happy about. Well I hope it works so I ...
reviews.x: Just received this today- Only complaint I have so far is that it doesn't have the applicator that is shown in the picture. The whole reason I went with this one Vs the other was because it had the felttip applicator & NOT the brush that most of them come with. As I was reading through the reviews that's what buyers were most happy about. Well I hope it works so I can overlook this detail

claims.text: Many reviewers report visible improvements in lash length, thickness, or fullness after using the product.
Several reviewers say it did not produce results for them, even after weeks or months of use.
Some reviewers highlight that it is gentle and does not cause irritation, unlike other serums they have tried.
A few reviewers mention negative reactions or concerns, including an allergic reaction and a change in ingredients.
Reviewers frequently note it is a good value compared to pricier alternatives like Latisse.
